description: This file implements an Android Debug Bridge (ADB) backend for interacting with Android devices, including classes and functions for device management, command execution, socket communication, and data handling.

classes.name: AdbBackend
classes.description: Main class providing methods to list connected Android devices via ADB.

classes.name: AdbDevice
classes.description: Represents an individual Android device, allowing command execution and socket management.

classes.name: BufferedSocketWrapper
classes.description: Handles socket communication with ADB, supporting data buffering, reading, writing, and mode switching.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes an ADB command over a socket connection, handling protocol specifics.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a socket connection to an ADB device for command or data transfer.

methods.name: encodeMessage
methods.description: Encodes a string message into a length-prefixed Buffer for ADB protocol communication.
